title: governed_record.retention_started event payload (v1)
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Produced by epd2_compliance_service.events. Minimum payload only: identifiers, enum values, timestamps and reason codes. It never carries a document or its bytes, a ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference, an authentication secret, an identity/eID/KYC attribute, a free-text case narrative, or the name of any natural person (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Signals that an explicit retention start was recorded for a governed record; until one exists, disposal eligibility fails closed.
